svg.title: Game completion and persistence (ports and adapters)
svg.desc: application/ports + storage/. Services depend only on the interfaces GameStore and PlayerQueries. PostgreSQL adapters implement them; Null adapters are wired when no DATABASE_URL is set. A finished game is saved once, keyed by completion_uuid.
svg.text: Game completion and persistence (ports and adapters)
application/ports + storage/. Services depend only on the interfaces GameStore and PlayerQueries. PostgreSQL adapters implement them;
Null adapters are wired when no DATABASE_URL is set. A finished game is saved once, keyed by completion_uuid.
<<interface>> = abstract class with only pure virtual methods; <<abstract>> = has some.
